title: Director, Marketing Technology & Innovation
location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 Pinterest is hiring a Director, Marketing Technology & Innovation, the most senior technology leader within our Marketing, Creative and Communications organization. To start, you will lead a hybrid team of Technical Program Managers (TPMs), AI Solutions Engineers, and third party platform engineering partners.
 This role starts as a player-coach. You will be hands-on alongside your teams, finding resourceful solutions as the function takes shape, with the autonomy to make a few strategic hires as it grows. The right person is a genuine leader and developer of people who has not lost touch with the technology itself, still knows how to build and close enough to the stack to make smart decisions and earn the trust of both marketers and engineers.

title: Fraud & Risk Analyst
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Trust and confidence is fundamental to the Lyft marketplace, and the Pay, Integrity & Identity (PII) Analytics team is charged with providing and ensuring that trust and safety to all customers. The PII Analytics team is one of the most critical teams that helps protect Lyft and enables the company to grow in a sustainable way. The team is fast-paced, high-energy, and meticulous in diagnosing emerging fraud patterns and preventing fraud loss before it can happen. We drill holes in all the products we launch and obsess over how to make our business impervious to fraud vectors. The team conducts a rigorous analysis of complex data sets and sets up multiple layers of business rules, models, and other processes to prevent potential fraud. We are a highly cross-functional team and regularly engage in discussion and reviews with stakeholders to prioritize plans for reducing fraud impact and introducing safety features.
 We’re looking for a rock-star to join a fast-paced environment to contribute to Fraud-related analysis and operations. This individual is responsible for investigating and developing solutions to prevent and mitigate third party fraud. This person will proactively identify fraud patterns and sources to minimize the company’s exposure to financial and reputational risk. The Senior Analyst will take ownership over multiple discrete fraud segments to develop and execute a strategy which addresses fraud in the earliest stages of detection. The Senior Analyst will define fraud prevention measures that are mindful of the impact on good user experience while inhibiting fraud actors’ ability to reach our platform.

title: National Security Policy, Senior Manager
description:
At Scale, we believe that AI will dramatically improve the world, and our mission is to accelerate the development of AI. As Scale continues to grow its Government Relations function, we are looking for a National Security Policy Senior Manager to support our engagements with the National Security apparatus, Congress, and the Administration.
 The successful candidate will have a track record of contributing to successful policy outcomes and the ability to help translate business objectives into effective policy engagement, working closely with and reporting to Scale's National Security Policy Lead.
 You will:
 Support Scale's AI policy engagement with the National Security apparatus
 Work with the Public Sector Business Unit to help shape and support programs at the DoD, Intelligence Agencies, and beyond, contributing to efforts around funding lines, requirements, and other items in support of growing our business
 Contribute to the formation and execution of Scale's policy strategy and priorities
 Coordinate internal collaboration with the Public Sector Business Unit (PSBU), to include contributing to workflow improvements for cross-functional efforts and building templates and playbooks for recurring internal processes
 Prepare briefing materials, memos, and talking points to support senior leader engagements and Scale leadership's own external engagements, such as meetings, conferences, and public forums
 Own stakeholder and relationship tracking to support long-term engagement planning, including post-engagement follow-through
 Provide administrative support with external consultants and advisors, as well as for executive engagements and travel
 Draft internal updates and synthesized analysis on policy announcements, legislative changes, and relevant national security developments — distilling what key developments mean for Scale's business and priorities — on a recurring cadence or as major news arises
 Develop and maintain a national security policy calendar…

title: AV Engineer
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 As an AV Engineer based in our London office, you'll design and implement the systems that enable world-class collaboration and communication across offices in the EMEA region. This role is critical as we rapidly expand our physical footprint, with plans for multiple new offices and expansions over the coming years.
 You'll be responsible for architecting AV solutions from concept through commissioning, ensuring our conference rooms, event spaces, and collaboration areas provide frictionless experiences that enable our teams to advance AI safety research. You'll help establish standards and systems that scale efficiently while pushing the boundaries of what's possible in workplace collaboration technology.
 This is an opportunity to shape how a cutting-edge AI research organization communicates and collaborates, building infrastructure that supports everything from small team meetings to company-wide all-hands broadcasts reaching thousands of remote participants.
 Responsibilities
 Lead AV design, procurement, and programming for new office builds, expansions, and retrofits across our global portfolio
 Create and maintain AV system designs including schematic drawings, line diagrams, and elevation plans
 Program and commission AV systems to meet specific use cases and user requirements
 Execute successful "first day of business" deployments for new offices, ensuring all systems are operational for day-one occupancy
 Attend build coordination meetings with architects, contractors, and workplace teams to drive AV requirements and integration
